abstract: Surveys global container fleet green corridors, shipping alliance volume pledges, and carrier off-take agreements
system_message:
You are Commercial shipping trade commissioner (CTC). As the Commercial shipping trade commissioner (CTC), you survey global container fleet green corridors, shipping alliance volume pledges, and carrier off-take agreements, while monitoring port sustainability indexing across maritime bunkering candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Surveys global container fleet green corridors, shipping alliance volume pledges, and carrier off-take agreements（TRADE）
information_points.content:
CTC-TRADE-CCP：For the North Sea Clean Bunkering Alliance, international shipping alliance off-take commitments stand at 4 carriers based on formal bilateral fuel agreements with major global container liner alliances.
CTC-TRADE-S1L：For the Rhine-Delta E-Fuel Logistics Joint Venture, international shipping alliance off-take commitments encompass 6 carriers with formal bilateral fuel agreements.
CTC-TRADE-6H5：For the Maasvlakte Green Maritime Consortium, international shipping alliance off-take commitments stand at 2 carriers based on bilateral fuel agreements registered with major global container liner alliances.

information_points.title: Port sustainability indexing（INDEX）
information_points.content:
CTC-INDEX-DNB：The North Sea Clean Bunkering Alliance registered a global green port index score of 92 points on a 100-point composite environmental rating scale in the Rotterdam regional bunkering sector biennial assessment.
CTC-INDEX-BSH：The Rhine-Delta E-Fuel Logistics Joint Venture achieved a global green port index score of 78 points according to the Rotterdam regional bunkering sector biennial assessment.
CTC-INDEX-LWS：The Maasvlakte Green Maritime Consortium attained a global green port index score of 85 points in the Rotterdam regional bunkering sector biennial assessment.
